scope: Read-only diagnostic, not independent acceptance of new ROOT source implementation or realC

findings.root_cause: Only background/paragraph_event participate in _prose_reading_packages native audit. risk becomes continuity_boundary, untouched in expanded original packages and never included in blocked. New finish singleton/open-start checks do not run on it.
findings.secondary_geometry: Existing edge also rejects true two-glyph wrapped final line due negative horizontal bbox overlap, despite body font/margins/line sequence. Including risk alone will defer or still miss it, not close it under current edge.
findings.source_resolution: Adjacent real block contains final two glyphs; can preserve whole original sentence only with bounded verified indentation/column-flow proof, otherwise explicit deferred. No model word completion.

findings.root_cause: char_start==0 is treated as left_closed even for first body block of a page continuing an unfinished previous-page body. Current edge forbids all cross-page links and sees header/footer boundaries; page-local terminal window is emitted as closed.
findings.source_resolution: Previous page names metal-gate Preforma Uniflash ALD product series and ends 性能需; first body next page starts 求的同时. Measured frames/margins/fonts compatible but actual cross-page original-ID proof must be added or task deferred, never infer omitted product from generic heading.

findings.root_cause: Window limits cut after a true sentence terminator and previous same-block terminator makes left_closed true. End-of-sentence geometry is not anaphor closure. statement_members protects dependence only inside one already-split window; it cannot bind antecedent in another preceding window.
findings.source_resolution: Prior original paragraph explicitly enumerates Preforma Uniflash metal-silicide integrated system and SA/SU,SPTi,ALDTiNM products; attach bounded exact source context refs for that collective scope or defer. Do not attribute to one guessed member.

implementation_suggestion.single_owner: One source-prose closure owner audits paragraph material before or independent of risk/project/background package kind; QA/table remain their explicit owners. Semantic package kind must not bypass closure.
dimensions: left/right physical sentence continuity including adjacent-page body carry
bounded actor/object/antecedent dependencies distinct from sentence terminator
implementation_suggestion.finite_existing_ports: Use existing native windows + required_context_unit_ids/citation_views context + bounded reading deferred diagnostics. No new Store, reviewer permit, model decision, company/page/substring exception or capacity increase.
implementation_suggestion.short_tail: Add measured same-body-column/first-line-indentation shape to shared geometry/source flow owner, retaining source/frame/font/line/section barriers. Do not broadly drop overlap restrictions; when no proof exists defer.
implementation_suggestion.cross_page: If last observed body is unterminated and first next-page body continues, require actual consecutive original body units, same source/frame/font/column and same active section with only proven headers/footers intervening. Missing previous page or competing boundary cannot be assumed complete.
implementation_suggestion.antecedent: Bound external original context at actual window split; reuse source-owned actor/object relation refs and retain collective ambiguity. More than one possible referent or over-limit closure produces honest deferred/unknown, not a guessed product.

TDD.expect: All prose kinds share closure audit; exact two original parts emitted only with qualified native lineflow, else finite deferred. Negative adjacent column/table/heading/QA/source/font controls remain rejected.

TDD.expect: Not independent just because char0. Verified original cross-page refs produce full source context within limits; unread prior page, new section, different column/source, standalone heading or role transition defer.
